steps: Chooser assigns a small pseudo-random subset from the fleet.
Tenant requests use only that subset.
One bad tenant or worker set overlaps with few other tenants, bounding impact.

lesson.scenario: A queue service assigns each tenant a small worker subset so one noisy tenant cannot consume the whole fleet.
